checks.explanation: The eventual Ukraine settlement framework discussed in late 2025/2026 talks broadly resembled these terms (Ukraine outside NATO, some Donbas autonomy, de facto recognition of Russian gains including Crimea), but as of mid-2026 no final settlement had actually been reached or implemented, so this specific prediction of an already-achieved outcome is not confirmed.
As of mid-2026 the Russia-Ukraine war remained unresolved with no final settlement reached, so the prediction's ultimate outcome cannot yet be scored.
